_comment: Scheduled macro events that move Indian markets. Hand-maintained from official calendars (Federal Reserve FOMC, US BLS, Election Commission, RBI). Times are IST unless marked. Only add a date once you have seen it on the primary source.

events.label: US midterm elections
events.note: Senate 35 seats and all 435 House seats. First polls close 6 PM ET.

events.label: US October jobs report
events.note: BLS non-farm payrolls. A strong number reinforces the December hike case.

events.label: FOMC meeting begins
events.note: Decision 9 December. Markets have priced a possible hike.
